links.outcome: LLM concordance with reference classification established by two independent pharmacists
links.effect: LLM concordance 96.0% (192/200; 95% CI, 92.3-98.3) with expert classification; 8 disagreements
links.quote: The LLM achieved a concordance rate of 96.0% (192/200; 95% CI, 92.3-98.3) with expert classification.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering of a reasoning LLM using pharmacist-reclassified incident reports to classify medication errors
Subcategorization of medication incident reports by LLM (76.5% accuracy)

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the classification accuracy of an LLM (O4-mini) on anonymized medical incident reports compared against human expert classification, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
